summary: Adds a new test file exercising watches through the router: streaming across forward, aggregate, single-tenant and in-process backends in both modes, watch-list parameters, timeoutSeconds, client disconnect, half-open breaker release, separate watch metrics, ending watches on backend change or service stop, and upgrade rejection. It changes no production code, so a skim is enough.
headline: New acceptance tests for router watch streaming, breaker, metrics and shutdown
reason: Entirely new test file with no production code; it only adds coverage for the watch behavior introduced elsewhere in the PR.
